name: Pheidi
desc: Personalized running plans for 5K to marathon that reschedule when life happens. Built on polarized training and real sports science. Free.
about: Most training plans are a PDF that assumes nothing goes wrong for sixteen weeks. Pheidi assumes something will. Miss a run, tweak a calf, take a vacation, and the plan reshuffles around it.
Under the hood it's polarized training: mostly easy miles, a little hard work, not much in between. Workouts export to your calendar and your Garmin.
note: Plans that bend instead of break.

name: Merge & Tell
desc: Watches merged pull requests and drafts the posts about them for X, Bluesky, LinkedIn, Discord, and a changelog. A human approves every draft before it goes out. It wrote the update notes on this site, too.
about: Shipping is the easy part. Telling anyone about it is where solo builders go quiet. Merge & Tell reads the diff of every merged pull request and drafts posts for the networks you pick, in your product's voice, aimed at the customer you describe.
Nothing posts until you approve it, and then it goes out from your own accounts. No third-party scheduler in the middle. The changelogs on this site come straight out of it.

name: Screenery
desc: A package registry for product screenshots. CI pushes them on every build, and each one gets a URL that updates itself on release. The live screenshots on this page come from it.

name: Auspex Fatalis
tag: Kill Team league app · Side project · 2026
desc: Runs a small in-person Kill Team league from your phone. Score reporting, a schedule with no rematches, standings, and a finals bracket. Sign in with Discord, since that's where the league already hangs out.
about: A league app for Kill Team, the Warhammer 40k skirmish game. Players report scores from the table, standings update, and the schedule avoids rematches. The season ends in a finals bracket.
Organizers get their own screens, a Discord hookup, and a weekly recap. It's dark and a little gothic, because the game is too.
note: Made for game night, not for spreadsheets.

name: Wooden Nutmeg
desc: Connecticut town budgets, traced to the primary sources. It started as eighteen years of Colchester budgets and now covers all 169 CT towns. Drafted with Claude, spot-checked against the source PDFs (yes, really).

image.alt: The Wooden Nutmeg homepage with the Colchester deep-dive: 18 budget books, 132 charts, 3,100 documents.

name: Wake Windows
desc: A nap planner for parents of babies up to two years old. Give it age, wake windows, and bedtime, and it lays out the day. Suggestions are checked against published guidance, and everything stays on your device.

image.alt: Wake Windows' today screen: a countdown to the next nap and the day's nap schedule.

name: EventBell
desc: Your Discord events announce themselves. Pick a channel once and every scheduled event gets reminders, on time, in everyone's time zone. Setup runs through an MCP server, so your agent can do it (there's a small web console for the humans).

image.alt: The EventBell homepage: "Your Discord events announce themselves."
